checks.name: mesh kind migration and uniquely named reorder retain supported overrides
duplicate names target current source indices precisely instead of every matching mesh
ambiguous source edits retain old edits as unresolved without guessing
explicit IDs and unique self-contained content survive names without collisions
OBJ geometry groups match rendered declarations, skipping empty aliases
unit and axis conversion use an independent root and preserve geometry/animation targets
legacy settings keep identity; invalid transforms reject before parenting changes
FBX ASCII and 32/64-bit binary IDs, units, animation and skin metadata agree
FBX runtime object IDs distinguish repeated names
new imports create a typed sidecar and preserve edits on forced reimport
normal JSON documents retain revision CAS and reject stale saves
ambiguous edits remain unresolved until an explicit reversible remap
source rename moves sidecar, preserves identity and redirects both paths
paired rename conflict and redirect failure restore both files
malformed import metadata is never overwritten by reimport
real FBX loader meshes use FBX IDs and file units
headless animation root motion includes import unit and up-axis conversion

limits: FBX binary 32/64-bit metadata header/ID parsing is tested with synthetic records; actual rendered FBX proof is ASCII triangle geometry through the installed Three loader
FBX runtime ID matching inherits Three numeric-ID precision. Unsafe IDs are not guessed by index

The native headless animation loader supports glTF/GLB, not every FBX animation feature
